title: Nuevo modelo open source: flowhmr-0.46B
dek: FlowHMR combines flow matching with physics-based reinforcement learning to recover faithful and physically plausible 3D human motion from monocular videos.
body:
## Ficha rápida

- fafsaf1/flowhmr-0.46B
- 0.5B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 2.4 GB (Portátil / GPU 4 GB)
- licencia other
- 41 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

FlowHMR combines flow matching with physics-based reinforcement learning to recover faithful and physically plausible 3D human motion from monocular videos.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/flowhmr/flowhmr · proyecto: https://flowhmr.github.io/ · pesos: https://huggingface.co/fafsaf1/flowhmr-0.46B Estrellas en GitHub: 360 Mencionado en: AI Search: Weight space programming, science agents, 3D generators, new Gemini Omni, new GPT Image: AI NEWS; AI Search: Weight space programming, new 3D models, Gemini Omni 1.2, GPT Image 2.6: AI NEWS

- 🎉🎉🎉 [2026-10-31] Our Hugging Face demo is now live! Reconstruct and preview 3D motion in your browser, with NPZ/FBX export. - 🚀🚀🚀 [2026-10-30] Updated inference acceleration: approximately 10× faster SAM feature extraction (with compile) and over 5× faster end-to-end inference (static camera, with compile) on our 300-frame A100 benchmark. See the resource and performance report. Get started with CLI inference or the Web demo.

We are releasing the full workflow, from data synthesis to training and evaluation, step by step.
